Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by worsening inflation outlook and plunging consumer sentiment. This directly impacts your tech/chip names, as higher inflation can mean higher rates, hurting growth stocks, and lower consumer confidence can hit demand.

Your holdings: SOXL (-51.32%) and SPAL (-31.99%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and your margin amplifies these significant drawdowns. Review their stops.

Watch: Keep an eye on inflation data and consumer sentiment reports. Also, monitor any developments around AI regulation, as this could impact your tech exposure.

Bottom line: Protect your capital in leveraged positions, especially with a worsening macro outlook.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or tightening your stop from 200. This leveraged position is down over 50% and decays.
SPAL: Review your stop at 21.38. This leveraged ETF is down significantly and moves fast.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The macro picture is concerning, and scanner setups are mostly "chasing" or lower grade.
